title: Resolve short ids consistently in all references; validate clean
description:
Problem: id inconsistency. Parents appear as full ids with a UUID (verified in this repo: kbs show 993960 prints "Parent: kbs-472c8199-14a0-44e6-8105-b5f0370f6d63" while tickets list as short ids like 472c81). In Papyrus kbs validate reported 16 "dependency target does not exist" errors for dependency targets written with short ids (not reproduced here; in this repo validate currently reports other errors: invalid dependency type 'blocks' and invalid parent-child relationship, which are a separate matter).

Acceptance:
- Short ids and unique prefixes resolve consistently in every reference: parent, dependencies, comments, CLI arguments, validate.
- kbs show displays parent and dependency ids in one consistent form (short id plus title).
- kbs validate on a board with short-id dependency targets reports no "dependency target does not exist" errors.
- Gherkin scenario for a dependency written as a short id.
right_now_summary: The fix is specified, but no implementation work or recent activity is recorded.
